summary: The City of Wells, Nevada strongly opposes the proposed implementation of Executive Order 11644 concerning off-road vehicles. The city argues that elected officials and interested citizens of each affected community should be given the opportunity to form committees to work with federal agency officials before any action is taken. They also object that federal agencies should not unilaterally decide which public lands are open or closed without community representation, and that insufficient public notice was given, as the draft was not made available to their community until late June.
